themes.mechanism: Same custom properties on :root, redefined under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). No manual theme toggle; color-scheme follows. theme-color meta: #14695f light, #0d1816 dark.

headline.purpose: One H1 per page, phrased as the page's question or state. 28/36px on inner pages, 28/40px on home.

label.purpose: Small sentence-case section heads inside panels, ink-2.

figure.purpose: Proof figures, scores and counts, always tabular.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system uses no box-shadows. Depth is tonal (porcelain vs white) plus the fired edge.

shadows.name: fired-edge
shadows.purpose: Thickness of pressable tiles: glaze-edge under glaze, ochre-edge under ochre, surface-2 under white.

shadows.name: fired-edge-pressed
shadows.purpose: Active state of every pressable tile: it sinks into the floor.

motion.name: lay
motion.value: @keyframes lay { 0% { transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(-6deg) scale(0.7); opacity: 0 } 100% { transform: none; opacity: 1 } }
motion.purpose: Signature: a tile is laid. 600ms with 45ms diagonal stagger on sign-in, 700ms on highlighted mosaic tiles, 900ms on the completion hero tile.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: @keyframes rise { from { transform: translateY(16px); opacity: 0 } to { transform: none; opacity: 1 } }

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion collapses to its end state.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 24px, larger headline and time tiles.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Verdigris rail replaces top bar and tab bar; practice feedback becomes a 420px side panel; exam answer sheet becomes a 260px side column; keyboard hints appear.

keyboard.ignore: Typing in inputs/textareas and any Cmd/Ctrl chord.

tileMastery.mastered: glaze ground, 4 ochre corners, on-glaze-2 rosette, ochre centre
tileMastery.mosaicSizing: 1x1 per epígraf; 2x2 when official exam weight is high; 10 columns, 4px gap, dense flow

narrative.overview:
The syllabus is a Catalan hydraulic-tile floor of 110 epígrafs, laid tile by tile as the student masters them. The shell is glazed ceramic: a verdigris rail and verdigris primary actions on a cool porcelain ground, with deep green-black ink. Ochre glaze is the one warm highlight, and Sant Pau brick red appears only when an answer is wrong. Everything else stays quiet so that long Catalan clinical text can be read comfortably.

The material idea is literal but restrained. Buttons and choice cards have a darker bottom edge, like the fired edge of a tile, and they sink into the floor when pressed. The geometric tile motif (quarter-circle corners filling in, then a rosette) belongs to the progress mosaic, the session-complete moment and the sign-in floor. It never decorates ordinary panels. Density is calm: one question per screen, generous tap targets, a fixed reading measure.

The system refuses the category default of a grey dashboard with one accent and the gamified cartoon path. Progress is a floor being laid, not points or streaks.
keyCharacteristics: Verdigris owns the frame (rail, primary actions, mastered tiles); porcelain owns the reading surface.
One grotesk (Hanken Grotesk) at heavy display weight with tight tracking; tabular figures for every number.
Glazed pressed-edge buttons and cards: a 4px darker bottom edge that collapses on press.
Tile mastery motif encodes six states; tile size in the mosaic encodes official exam weight.
Light and dark themes follow the system setting; every color is a CSS custom property with both values.

rules.name: The Brick Means Wrong Rule
rules.body: Brick red is reserved for wrong answers. Never use it for destructive actions, warnings, branding or emphasis; warnings and "may be outdated" notices are ochre.

rules.name: The One Warm Glaze Rule
rules.body: Ochre is the only warm color and marks the single thing worth returning to (resume, review mistakes, flags, the mastered rosette). One ochre action per screen.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Question stems and explanations never run wider than 62ch; case narratives 68ch. The page can be wide; the reading line cannot.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or be compared (scores, counts, timer, dates, answer grid) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Fired Edge Rule
rules.body: Thickness is a bottom border in the darker shade of the same glaze, never a drop shadow. Pressable things have it; static panels do not.

dos: **Do** give every pressable control the fired edge: a 4px bottom border in the darker shade of its own fill, collapsing to 1px with a 3px drop on press.
**Do** keep verdigris for the frame and the primary action, and limit each screen to one ochre action.
**Do** use the tile motif to show mastery, and let tile size carry official exam weight.
**Do** keep question stems and explanations within 62ch and set numbers in tabular figures.
**Do** define every new color as a custom property with both light and dark values.
**Do** keep focus blue as the only focus indicator so focus never looks like selection.
donts: **Don't** use brick red for anything other than a wrong answer.
**Don't** use box-shadows for depth; use porcelain against white and the fired edge.
**Don't** put the geometric tile motif on ordinary panels, buttons or headers; it lives in the mosaic, the completion moment and the sign-in floor.
**Don't** add a second typeface; hierarchy comes from Hanken Grotesk weight, size and tracking.
**Don't** set labels in uppercase with letter-spacing; small heads are 14px bold sentence case.
